‘We need a culture of discipline’: Recto urges public to change disposal habits. The Marcos administration is pursuing an “all-out” campaign against garbage and flooding while urging local governments and communities to strengthen discipline in waste disposal, Executive Secretary Ralph Recto said. Recto said this after leading a meeting of key government agencies and local government representatives on Aug. 20 to discuss faster clearing operations and longer-term solutions to waste management. In his remarks, Recto said the national government and local government units (LGUs) are intensifying collection, clearing, and waste management operations as part of efforts to address flooding and garbage problems. “Lumalabas sa aming pagpupulong na walang garbage crisis sa Metro Manila, pero may krisis sa hindi wastong pagtatapon ng basura (Our meeting showed that there is no garbage crisis in Metro Manila, but there is a crisis in improper waste disposal),” he said. The Palace official said preventing garbage from reaching waterways should begin at the community level, making LGUs a “first line of defense” against flooding and waste. “Kailangan nating magkaroon ng malawakang pagpapalaganap ng kultura ng disiplina (We need to widely promote a culture of discipline),” Recto said. “Sabi nga natin dati, ang basurang itinapon mo nang hindi wasto, babalik din sayo (As we have said before, garbage that you improperly throw away will come back to you),” he added. Recto said the government’s campaign requires a “whole-of-society approach,” including greater participation from citizens in proper waste segregation and disposal. He warned that garbage dumped in streets and drainage systems can eventually clog waterways and be carried toward Manila Bay during heavy rains. “Kapag ginawang basurahan ang kanal at mga kalye, nagiging expressway ng basura ang mga ilog pagbuhos ng malakas na ulan (When canals and streets are turned into garbage dumps, rivers become expressways for garbage when heavy rain falls),” he said. Recto also urged Filipinos to practice the same discipline in waste disposal at home that they observe when they are abroad, including following collection schedules, segregating waste, and using proper disposal facilities. “Hindi mahirap gawin ito dahil kapag nasa ibang bansa ang Pilipino, marunong tayong sumunod sa batas: sa oras ng koleksyon ng basura, sa pag-segregate at sa pagtatapon sa tamang lugar (This is not difficult to do because when Filipinos are abroad, we know how to follow the law: observing garbage collection schedules, segregating waste, and disposing of it in the proper place),” he said. Under the Department of Public Works and Highways’ Oplan Kontra Baha, clearing, declogging, and desilting operations are continuing with the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority and LGUs, while pumping stations and logistics for garbage hauling and disposal are also being strengthened. The government is also studying the use of part of the LGUs’ National Tax Allotment for solid waste management projects and the creation of a Cleanest Barangay Program, while expanding initiatives such as trash traps, Bayanihan sa Estero or TUPAD, Estero Rangers, Environmental Monitoring Officers, the Adopt-an-Estero Program, and solid waste management equipment for 16 LGUs.

Another rainy week over parts of the Philippines as Typhoon Saudel set to enter PAR. The Philippines could face another round of heavy monsoon rains this week as the typhoon with the international name “Saudel” is expected to enter the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) and enhance the southwest monsoon or “habagat.” Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) weather specialist Obet Badrina on Sunday, Aug. 23, said Saudel is likely to enter PAR on Monday, Aug. 24, but is unlikely to make landfall in the country. Saudel was located 2,245 kilometers east of extreme Northern Luzon as of Sunday, and is expected to briefly enter the northeastern boundary of PAR. Once inside PAR, PAGASA will assign it the local name “Obet.” “Bagamat nga itong Saudel, base po sa track niya, medyo maliit naman yung posibilidad or almost less likely po na ito ay tumama sa kalupaan ng ating bansa, inaasahan natin na palalakasin nito yung habagat bandang araw nga po ng Martes hanggang Miyerkules (Although Saudel has a low, or almost unlikely, chance of making landfall in the country based on its track, we expect it to strengthen the habagat around Tuesday to Wednesday, Aug. 25 to 26),” Badrina said. The enhanced habagat is expected to bring occasional heavy rains, particularly over western Luzon and Visayas. “Once na pumasok ito ng Philippine Area of Responsibility, bandang midweek po, asahan ng mga kababayan natin na magkakaroon na ulit tayo ng mga occasional heavy rains (Once it enters the Philippine Area of Responsibility around midweek, our countrymen should expect occasional heavy rains again),” Badrina said. PAGASA is also monitoring two other tropical cyclones outside PAR. The tropical cyclone formerly known as “Neneng” has strengthened again after weakening into a low-pressure area, but Badrina said it has little chance of re-entering PAR. Another tropical cyclone located 1,205 kilometers east of Eastern Visayas is expected to move northeastward and may not enter PAR. “Itong bagyo naman sa may silangan ng Visayas ay posibleng sumunod siya sa bagyong Saudel. So nagkakaroon po sila ngayon ng interaction (This cyclone east of the Visayas could possibly follow Saudel, so the two systems are currently interacting),” he said. As early as Sunday, Badrina said the habagat is already bringing heavy rains to Batanes and cloudy skies with scattered rains over Metro Manila, Ilocos Region, Cordillera Administrative Region, Central Luzon, Rizal, Cavite, Batangas, Occidental Mindoro, and the rest of Cagayan Valley Meanwhile, generally fair weather is expected over Bicol Region, Visayas, and Mindanao, although localized rain showers and thunderstorms remain possible.

Bimby Aquino hopes young people learn about his late grandfather Ninoy Aquino. On the 43rd anniversary of Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino Jr.’s death, his grandson, Bimby Aquino, shared his hope that the younger generation would take time to learn more about the late senator and his legacy through research. Kris Aquino's youngest son was present at his grandfather's tomb for a mass that was held last Aug. 21. In an interview , Bimby urged young people like him, who were not yet born when Ninoy was alive, to take time to learn more about him. "Research po. There’s a lot of videos of Lolo on YouTube. You’ll really get to know him as a person. We never had a conversation with him. But just research and trust reliable sources," Bimby said. Also present at the gathering was Bimby's cousin, Francis Joseph “Kiko” Aquino Dee, who also shared his thoughts on learning about his late grandfather. "We’re learning about him the same way most Filipinos do. Hindi namin siya naabutan. So, we hope that people can get to know him the way we did," Francis said. When asked what he would tell Ninoy if given the chance to speak with him, Bimby said: “Words cannot express the amount of things I want to say to him. But [I would say] thank you, thank you for doing what he did for our country and for being a good dad to my mom and to my titas and Tito Noy.”

Shroud of Turin exhibit returns to Manila Cathedral after 50 years. Fifty years after the Shroud of Turin was first exhibited in the Philippines, a larger exhibition featuring a full-size replica of the famed cloth, relics associated with Christ's Passion, and other religious artifacts will open at the Manila Cathedral in Intramuros this October. The Shroud of Turin Exhibit at The Manila Cathedral will formally open on Oct. 2, with public viewing scheduled from Oct. 3 to 16. Organized by the Equestrian Order of the Holy Sepulchre of Jerusalem (EOHSJ) Lieutenancy for the Philippines, the exhibition marks five decades since the Shroud was first brought to the country in 1976 with the imprimatur of then Manila Archbishop Jaime Cardinal Sin. At the heart of the exhibit is a full-size replica of the Shroud of Turin, the centuries-old linen cloth bearing the faint image of a man who appears to have been tortured and crucified. For centuries, many Christians have believed the man depicted on the cloth to be Jesus Christ. The Shroud, however, has also remained one of Christianity's most studied and debated artifacts, with questions surrounding its origin and the formation of its mysterious image continuing to draw the interest of historians, scientists and believers. The original Shroud is kept in Turin, Italy, and is only displayed to the public on rare occasions. Visitors to the Manila Cathedral will instead see a full-size replica that, according to the organizers, has the same dimensions as the original and retains its photonegative characteristics. The replica was also blessed by Pope Benedict XVI in 2011 and Pope Francis in 2015, the organizers said. But the October exhibition will offer more than the image on the cloth. Among its highlights is a full-size sculpture of the “Man of the Shroud,” carved from baticulin wood by Filipino artist Reden Ballesteros and specially commissioned for the exhibition by the EOHSJ Philippine Lieutenancy. The sculpture presents the body and wounds seen on the image of the Shroud, giving visitors a three-dimensional interpretation of the man depicted on the linen. The exhibit will also feature the Arma Christi Reliquary, which contains relics that organizers identify as being associated with the life, Passion and death of Jesus, as well as relics of the Twelve Apostles and other saints. Other displays will focus on images of the Holy Face of Jesus and relics associated with saints whose lives and spirituality were connected with devotion to the Holy Face. For the faithful, the exhibition will also offer an opportunity for prayer and reflection. Organizers said visitors may have the opportunity to obtain a plenary indulgence through the Arma Christi Reliquary, subject to the conditions prescribed by the Catholic Church. A return 50 years in the making The 2026 exhibit also carries a distinctly Philippine story. The first Shroud of Turin exhibition in the country was held in 1976 and became a significant moment in the development of the Holy Face devotion in the Philippines. Among those connected with the earlier exhibit was Mother Maria Elisabetta Patrizi, founder of the Franciscan Family of Mary Immaculate, who accompanied Msgr. Giulio Ricci to Manila. Ricci, then a Vatican archivist and a pioneering researcher in sindonology, the study of the Shroud of Turin, delivered a lecture during the opening of the 1976 exhibition. Five decades later, the upcoming exhibit will once again bring a Shroud expert from abroad to Manila. Fr. Joseph Spence of the Franciscan Family of Mary Immaculate, a priest and professor at the Pontifical Athenaeum Regina Apostolorum in Rome, is expected to deliver a lecture on the Shroud on Oct. 2 for invited guests. The 2026 exhibition is also being mounted with the participation of the Missionary Sisters of the Holy Face of Jesus, whose congregation traces part of its history to the Holy Face devotion that grew in the Philippines following the earlier Shroud exhibition. Between faith and mystery The Shroud of Turin occupies a unique place in Christianity. For believers, it is a powerful image connected to the suffering, death and resurrection of Christ. For researchers, it remains an artifact whose history and unusual image have generated decades of scientific examination and debate. The October exhibition does not bring the original Shroud from Turin to Manila. Instead, it seeks to bring Filipinos closer to the story surrounding it through a full-size replica, visual interpretations, religious artifacts, and displays connected to Christ's Passion and the Holy Face devotion. Fifty years after the Shroud was first exhibited in the Philippines, that story will return to the Manila Cathedral, where faith, history and one of Christianity's enduring mysteries will once again meet. The Shroud of Turin Exhibit at The Manila Cathedral will formally open on Oct. 2, with public viewing scheduled from Oct. 3 to 16.

Abrahano is Metro Manila's new top cop. Police Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano vowed police visibility and quick response in Metro Manila as he assumed the top post of the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO). Abrahano assumed the top police post in Metro Manila as officer-in-charge on Sunday, Aug. 23, or the date that his predecessor, Maj. Gen. Anthony A. Aberin who held the NCRPO director post since 2024, reached the mandatory retirement age of 56. In his speech, Abrahano said Metro Manila residents should expect active measures to prevent crime and quick response in every call for assistance and emergency situations. “Our duty is simple to be ready, to respond properly and to earn the public's trust. Today I accept the responsibility of leading the NCRPO. The NCRPO, under my leadership, will be an active partner in ensuring a secure, peaceful and progressive Metro Manila,” said Abrahano. For Abrahano, the role of the PNP based on the instruction of PNP chief Gen. Jos Melencio C. Nartatez, Jr., is simple: Police service that is fast and felt by the people. And this, he said, is exactly what Metro Manila residents should expect from the NCPO under his leadership. “To the people of Metro Manila, expect your police to be present, responsive, professional and respectful. You don’t need influence, or connections to receive proper police service,” said Abrahano. “Our commitment is simple: every beat covered, every call answered,” said Abrahano. A member of the PNP Academy Class of 1996, Abrahano was the director of the Police Regional Office 10, or Northern Mindanao before his appointment as NCRPO director. He was then the director of the Caraga regional police when he was tapped to head the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) and replaced its head who figured in a controversy over the missing sabungeros case. He briefly served as CIDG as he was replaced by Maj. Gen. Robert Alexander Morico. After that Abrahano was named as head of the Northern Mindanao regional police. Other positions held by Abrahano was the head of the Aviation Security Group and provincial director of Ilocos Norte.

Pope Leo calls for dialogue over conflict, says young Catholics are a sign of hope. SAN MARINO (AP) — Pope Leo XIV used a visit to the tiny landlocked San Marino and a major Catholic gathering in the Italian city of Rimini on Saturday to issue one of his strongest appeals yet against war, polarization and social division, urging believers to foster dialogue and friendship in a fractured world. Speaking to tens of thousands in Rimini, Leo warned against a culture that "rearms minds, words and nations" and argued that Christians must respond with mercy, encounter and a commitment to peace. He also delivered a message of encouragement to young Catholics, telling them they are "a sign that the future is promising, and not a threat!" Earlier, in San Marino, Leo addressed local authorities of the world's oldest surviving republic and reflected on the legacy of Saints Marino and Leone, whom he credited with helping create a society rooted in freedom, mutual respect and community. The pope said the two saints translated the Christian message into "a new community and political model, strongly characterized by the Christian principles of freedom, mutual respect and communion" — a legacy that he said continues to shape the republic today. San Marino, a nation of about 35,000 people completely surrounded by Italy, traces its origins to the fourth century. It is governed by a 60-member parliament that elects two captains regent every six months to serve jointly as heads of state, a power-sharing arrangement designed to prevent the concentration of authority. Using the micro state as an example, Leo argued that small political communities can offer lessons in public service and social cohesion at a time of growing division and distrust. Leo is the third pope to visit San Marino, after St. John Paul II visited in 1982 and Pope Benedict XVI came in 2011. The American pontiff praised a society "built on respect for one's own freedom and that of others and above all on respect for the sacred Will of God." He warned that modern societies face increasing threats from violence, social fragmentation and ideologies that put self-interest ahead of the common good. "We live in a world wounded by many conflicts," the pope said, citing growing violence, closures and fear of others. He urged Christians to respond through forgiveness, solidarity and concern for the vulnerable. Leo also described San Marino as a "laboratory of good politics" and called for public life to uphold the dignity of every human person "from conception to natural death" — language commonly used by Vatican officials and Catholic leaders when referring to church opposition to abortion and euthanasia. In 2021, San Marino voters approved a referendum legalizing abortion during the first 12 weeks of pregnancy, overturning a decades-old ban. The referendum represented a significant change in law and public policy in a country with deep Catholic roots. While Leo did not directly address the referendum, he repeatedly stressed the need for political, social and economic systems to place human dignity at their center. He warned against models that present themselves as liberating but ultimately fail to serve the human person and the common good. A call for mercy in a divided world Later Saturday, Leo addressed the annual Rimini Meeting — a major Catholic cultural festival organized by the Communion and Liberation movement — urging Catholics to respond to a world marked by war, division and inequality with dialogue, friendship and encounter. He said peace is built by people "who love to encounter one another and are not afraid to engage with one another," arguing that human dignity must come before political, social and ideological divisions. In some of his strongest comments to date on global tensions, he warned against what he described as a growing culture of confrontation and militarization. Christians should recognize that "there can be no enemies," and that even opponents are "a brother or sister to be looked in the eye and encountered in truth," Leo added. He urged Catholics to challenge systems that fuel poverty, inequality and conflict. "Let us expose unjust structures of power that lie at the root of poverty, inequality, war and environmental disasters," he said, while urging believers to free "work from the idolatry of profit" and to "disarm technological development whenever it becomes invasive and destructive." A significant portion of the pope's speech focused on young people, whom Leo portrayed as a source of hope at a time when many fear the future. Encouraging young Catholics to engage with society rather than retreat into closed communities, he urged them: "Do not be afraid to give yourselves fully!" and "Go forth to meet everyone!" Echoing themes championed by his predecessor, Pope Francis, Leo also encouraged Catholics to embrace listening and dialogue, arguing that the church grows through the attraction of authentic witness rather than proselytism.

P292.4-M shabu hidden in ‘talc stones’ seized at Manila port. The Bureau of Customs (BOC) and Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) seized around 43 kilograms of suspected shabu worth P292.4 million hidden in a shipment declared as talc stones from Afghanistan at the Manila International Container Port (MICP). The two 20-foot containers were subjected to a 100% physical examination following risk profiling and monitoring of high-risk shipments, the BOC said. During the inspection, authorities discovered suspected illegal drugs concealed inside fabric pouches coated with a plaster-like material and designed to resemble talc stones, allowing them to blend with the shipment’s declared contents. Laboratory testing of representative samples later confirmed the presence of methamphetamine hydrochloride, or shabu, according to the BOC. Authorities also noted similarities between the shipment and an earlier Afghanistan-linked container intercepted at the MICP on Feb. 10, 2026. The earlier shipment was declared as marble but was found to contain around 40 kilograms of dangerous drugs worth P272 million, the BOC said. BOC Commissioner Nepomuceno said the latest seizure highlights the importance of strict risk profiling and monitoring of high-risk shipments. “Ang operasyong ito ay patunay na effective ang mahigpit na profiling at risk management ng Bureau of Customs (This operation proves the effectiveness of the Bureau of Customs’ strict profiling and risk management),” Nepomuceno said. He also credited the PDEA for its role in the operation. The inspection was jointly conducted by the PDEA and BOC through the Customs Anti-Illegal Drug Task Force (CAIDTF), Customs Intelligence and Investigation Service (CIS), Enforcement and Security Service (ESS), X-ray Inspection Project (XIP) and other concerned units. The BOC said the operation forms part of its continuing efforts to strengthen border controls and prevent illegal drugs from entering the country.

Manila rescuers use thermal, AI drones to find missing 13-year-old at Baseco Beach. Manila rescuers are using thermal and artificial intelligence (AI)-powered drones in the continuing search for a 13-year-old boy who was reportedly last seen swimming at Baseco Beach in Port Area, Manila, the Manila Police District (MPD) said on Sunday, August 23. The Manila City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Department (MCDRRMD) Search and Rescue Team deployed a thermal drone and an enterprise drone equipped with AI capabilities to aid the search and retrieval operation. According to Ramon Jefferson Verano, officer-in-charge of the Emergency Data and Preparedness (EDP) and chief of the Manila Innovations Integrated GIS and Data Hub, the thermal drone can help detect heat signatures, while the AI-powered enterprise drone can assist in identifying people or other objects across wide and difficult-to-reach areas. The drone technology was deployed as rescuers continued efforts to locate the missing child, who was reportedly last seen swimming at Baseco Beach. Meanwhile, personnel of the Manila Police District's (MPD) Baseco Police Station (PS-13) monitored the search operation at Babuyan Block 17, Barangay 649, Baseco Compound at around 6:10 p.m. on Aug. 16. Police said personnel from the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), Manila City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MCDRRMO), Barangay 649 Public Safety Officers (BPATS), and Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) were in the area conducting search and rescue operations. The PCG told police that it had received a report through 911 regarding an alleged drowning incident, prompting the search operation. Police personnel continued to verify the report and sought individuals who may have information regarding the incident. The PCG said the reported drowning remained under verification while search and rescue operations were ongoing. Drone footage released by the MCDRRMD showed the technology being used during the continuing operation.

DSWD on blue alert as Typhoon Saudel nears Philippine area of responsibility. The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) is keeping its disaster response operations on Blue Alert as Typhoon Saudel approaches the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR). Saudel, which will be given the local name “Obet” once it enters PAR, is expected to cross the country’s northeastern boundary on Monday, Aug. 24. DSWD said its Disaster Response Command Center remains on Blue Alert even after the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council downgraded the alert status of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Operations Center from Red to Blue on Aug. 20. “Although the alert status has been lowered, the DSWD continues to monitor and coordinate with various government agencies and local governments that need assistance due to the previous storms and enhanced southwest monsoon. The DSWD is also ready to respond to any possible effects of the new weather disturbance outside the PAR,” DSWD Disaster Response and Management Group Assistant Secretary Irene Dumlao said on Sunday, Aug. 23. Dumlao also said the agency has standby funds amounting to ₱667 million ready to be utilized during disaster response operations. At least 3.7 million boxes of family food packs are also available in strategic hubs, spokes, and last-mile areas nationwide. These include about 369,000 boxes at the Luzon Disaster Resource Center in Pasay City, 512,000 boxes at the Visayas Disaster Resource Center in Mandaue City, and 174,000 boxes at the Mindanao Disaster Resource Center in Butuan City. Dumlao said the DSWD continues to coordinate with its field offices and local government units as several areas recover from the effects of previous tropical cyclones and the enhanced southwest monsoon or “habagat.” DSWD also reminded the public to remain alert for possible flooding and landslides as heavy rains may continue in some areas due to various weather systems affecting the country. “We urge the public to remain prepared and listen to the advisories and instructions of their local officials to avoid any untoward incidents that may be caused by bad weather,” Dumlao said.

Police step up visibility, safety exercises in Western Visayas, Mimaropa schools. Police forces In Western Visayas and Mimaropa have stepped up school safety measures and emergency response following another gun attack inside school premises in Zamboanga City and the confiscation of a revolver from a student in a town in Cebu. In Western Visayas, Brig. Gen. Randulf T. Tuaño, director of the Police Regional Office- 6, said they have been conducting simulation exercises in schools and actually held eight from Aug. 14 to 20 in some parts of the regions. The exercises include four scenarios: presence of active shooter, presence of knife-wielding student, hostage-taking incident, and bomb threat. “These were all conducted in coordination with school administrators, force multipliers, and other concerned agencies to enhance awareness and preparedness, strengthen security readiness, and improve emergency response capabilities within school premises,” said Tuaño. He said he already tasked all police commanders down to the municipal level to sustain simulation exercises and closer coordination with local government units, education officials, emergency responders, and other partner agencies for the safety of students and learning spaces. Tuaño emphasized that preparedness is an essential part of keeping schools safe and should be continuously strengthened through cooperation among the police, school authorities, local government, emergency responders, parents, and the community. “Our objective is preparedness, not alarm. We want our schools and responding agencies to know their roles and be able to act quickly, calmly, and in coordination should an emergency occur. The safety of our students, teachers, and school personnel will always be a priority,” Tuaño said. In Mimaropa, Brig. Gen. Christopher R. Dela Cruz, director of the Police Regional Office 4B, said police presence in schools were further intensified through beat patrols and school visitations in schools. From June 30 to Aug 18, Dela Cruz said a total of 2,422 school-related activities were done involving 4,071 uniformed personnel who initiated school visitations, security assistance, lectures and workshops, simulation exercises and coordination activities in Oriental and Occidental Mindoro, Marindque, Romblon and Palawan. “Every child deserves to feel safe when going to school. Our responsibility is to make sure that our police presence is felt where our learners are, and that when a concern arises, our personnel are ready to respond,” Dela Cruz said. Dela Cruz also reminded firearm owners to exercise the highest degree of responsibility in the possession, storage, and handling of firearms and ammunition and to ensure that these are properly secured and inaccessible to children and other unauthorized persons. “Responsible firearm ownership is part of keeping our families, schools, and communities safe. If there is a firearm in your home, make sure it is properly secured and that only authorized persons can access and handle it,” Dela Cruz said. Police have been providing assistance to schools since the first case of school mass shooting in the country. On Tuesday, police will also participate in the nationwide simultaneous safety drill initiated by the Department of Education.

House leader: P802-M alocation in 2027 budget can help stop potential school violence. House Minority Leader and 4Ps Party-list Rep. Marcelino “Nonoy” Libanan says the 2027 National Expenditure Program (NEP) has a feature that could go a long way in nipping potential school violence in the bud. According to Libanan, the national government plans to spend P802 million next year to hire a total of 2,021 new guidance counselors for public elementary and high schools in a bid to strengthen the mental health services of the Department of Education (DepEd). “We are all for increased government spending to bolster the support system around every learner. A child who is struggling should have ready access to a trained school professional who can listen and help,” Libanan said on Sunday, Aug. 23. Libanan says the fresh funding allocation is especially timely as schools face growing concerns over bullying, student mental health and threats of violence. “Early intervention is critical. We should be able to recognize warning signs and provide help before a problem becomes a tragedy,” he noted. The proposed 2027 national budget specifically provides P802 million for the creation of 1,800 new School Counselor Associate I positions and 221 new School Division Counselor positions for DepEd, according to Libanan. The 2027 NEP--the basis for next year's General Appropriations Bill (GAB) or proposed national budget--is pegged at P7.2 trillion, the largest in the country's history. The Minority Leader said guidance counselors play an important role in helping teachers, parents and school administrators understand and respond to students who may be experiencing emotional, behavioral or psychological difficulties. “Guidance counselors are part of our first line of defense. They help our schools become safer and more supportive communities for children,” Libanan said. Private elementary and high schools also urged to invest in additional professional guidance and counseling services Libanan also expressed hope that private elementary and high schools would increase their own investments in professional guidance and counseling services. “We are counting on private elementary and high schools to also do their share. The well-being of our children is a shared responsibility,” he added. 2 school shootings in 2 months The increase in guidance personnel comes as the country reels from two fatal school shootings in a span of less than two months-- something that has caused alarm among House members . On June 22, two students aged 14 and 15 and armed with a 9mm Glock pistol and a .38-caliber revolver opened fire at San Jose National High School in Tacloban City. Three fellow students were killed, while 20 others were injured. Then, on Aug. 18, a 14-year-old Grade 8 student opened fire at the high school building of Ateneo de Zamboanga University in Zamboanga City. The shooter gunned down a 15-year-old Grade 10 student before taking his own life. Authorities said the assailant had brought a pistol and a rifle into the school and had partly livestreamed the attack via a body-worn camera. “These incidents show why we must invest not only in physical security but also in the emotional and psychological support available to our students. Prevention must begin long before a crisis occurs,” Libanan said.

Lean PH boxing team out to end Asian Games gold-medal drought. The Asian Games-bound Philippine boxing team may be without Eumir Marcial -- its lone medalist from the previous edition -- but it is bringing a formidable arsenal to this year’s Games in Japan next month. Olympic medalists Nesthy Petecio, Carlo Paalam and Aira Villegas headline the lean six-fighter PH team, which aims to end the country’s 16-year drought for an Asian Games boxing gold medal. Rey Saludar was the last Filipino boxer to win an Asian Games gold, claiming the title at the 2010 edition in Guangzhou, China. Joining them are Junmilardo Ogayre (men’s 60kg), Petecio’s brother, Norlan (men’s 70kg) and Riza Pasuit (women’s 54kg). Marcial, who won the silver in the 2022 edition in Hangzhou, China, is skipping this year’s Games due to conflict of schedule with his pro fight. Nesthy, 34, is expected to go all-out in the women’s 60 kg -- a slightly heavier weight class from the 57kg division where she won a silver in the 2020 Tokyo and a bronze in the 2024 Paris Olympics. An Asian Games medal is the only major title missing from Nesthy’s trophy collection, having won silver in the 2020 Tokyo and bronze in the 2024 Paris Olympics, one gold and one silver medal in the world championships, one silver and two bronze medals in the Asian Championships, and two gold, three silver and two bronze medals in the Southeast Asian Games. She competed in the 2022 Asian Games edition in Hangzhou, China in the 57kg division, but lost in the Round of 16 to Chinese Taipei’s Lin Yu-ting, who eventually won the gold medal. Paalam, a 2020 Tokyo Olympics silver winner, meanwhile, eyes to eclipse his previous Asian Games feat of a bronze medal in the 2018 edition in Jakarta, Indonesia when he competes in the men’s 55kg. He competed in the 57kg in Hangzhou, but lost to eventual champion Abdumalik Khalokov of Uzbekistan in the quarterfinals. Villegas, a 2024 Paris Olympics bronze winner, for her part, is seeing action in the women’s 51kg with hopes of redeeming herself from her last Asian Games appearance in Hangzhou where she lost in the opening round.

Rider hits cop while fleeing Marikina checkpoint. A 26-year-old Marikina police officer sustained injuries after being hit by a motorcycle rider who attempted to escape during a checkpoint in Barangay Fortune, police said Saturday, Aug. 22. The Marikina City Police Station said the incident occurred around 2:35 a.m. on Thursday, Aug. 20, after personnel from Police Sub-Station 7 flagged down the rider along Fortune Avenue in front of a gasoline station. Authorities stopped the rider, identified as “Michael,” for inspection after noticing that his back rider was not wearing a helmet. During the inspection, the rider allegedly drove off suddenly and hit the police officer, who fell to the ground and sustained injuries to various parts of his body. Police immediately pursued and arrested the rider. The injured officer, Pat. Christian John Rodriguez, was given first aid before being taken to the Amang Rodriguez Memorial Medical Center (ARMMC) for treatment. The suspect is currently under custody at the Marikina CPS Custodial Facility and is facing charges of Direct Assault and Resistance and Disobedience to a Person in Authority. Eastern Police District chief Brig. Gen. Melecio M. Buslig Jr. commended the police officers for their alertness and professionalism following the incident. "Our police officers risk their lives every day in the performance of their duties. Acts of violence against law enforcement personnel will never be tolerated. ‘Saudel’ may intensify into a super typhoon before PAR entry. The typhoon with the international name “Saudel” may intensify into a super typhoon before entering the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) on Monday, Aug. 24, said the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) on Sunday, Aug. 23. As of 10 a.m. Sunday, Saudel was located 2,085 kilometers east of extreme Northern Luzon, outside PAR. It had maximum sustained winds of 165 kilometers per hour (kph) near the center and gustiness of up to 205 kph. PAGASA said Saudel is forecast to reach super typhoon strength, with maximum sustained winds of at least 180 kph, by Monday before entering PAR. As of Sunday, the typhoon was moving west-northwestward at 25 kph. “Saudel will continue moving generally west-northwestward for the next three days before moving generally westward for the remaining forecast period. The center of Saudel is forecast to enter the northeastern boundary of the Philippine Area of Responsibility by tomorrow morning or afternoon (Aug. 24),” PAGASA said. Based on the forecast track, Saudel is expected to remain over the Philippine Sea and exit PAR by Tuesday, Aug. 25. However, PAGASA said a more westward track beyond 48 hours could result in Saudel remaining within PAR beyond Tuesday. Meanwhile, PAGASA is also monitoring a tropical depression east of Southern Luzon, outside PAR, which may enter the country’s monitoring area. “Saudel will be given the domestic name either Obet or Pilandok, depending on the order of the entry,” PAGASA said. Saudel is less likely to directly affect the country’s weather and sea conditions in the next three days, PAGASA said. Although the typhoon is not expected to directly affect the country, it may enhance the southwest monsoon or “habagat” and bring rainy conditions, particularly over the western sections of Luzon and Visayas. 'Crack down on them like porn sites': House officials tell gov't agencies to block China misinformation pages. Officials from the House of Representatives want the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) and other government agencies to show that they mean business when it comes to stifling so-called China propaganda pages online that spread misinformation on the West Philippine Sea (WPS) issue. House impeachment adviser and prosecution panel spokesperson Robert Ace Barbers specifically pointed to the Facebook page Media Unlocked as a source of such fake news that shamelessly twists facts to fit its narrative. Barbers couldn't help but liken these China propaganda pages and its corruptive content to pornograpic websites. "NTC should block these China misinformation pages the same way that government cracks down on porn sites. To follow or subscribe to these pages should be deemed unpatriotic," he said. As part of its powers, the NTC can order internet service providers (ISPs) to block certain websites, although its authority is limited and subject to legal challenges The NTC oversees ISPs and public telecom entities. It can issue directives requiring them to block malicious domains, especially when coordinated with the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT). Barbers said the NTC should at the very least look into having the particular Facebook page flagged for fake news. He also suggested that the relevant agencies come up with a video explainer to debunk the claims made by Media Unlocked. "They should take it down or better yet before taking it down an explainer from from our end will discuss frame by frame the misinformation they're spreading just like what the Chinese girl in the video is doing," he said. "So that even it is seen by the Filipino youth, they will be able to discern the fake news from the real one," noted the former House quad-committee (quad-comm) overall chairman. The particular video that Barbers was referring to claimed that a Philippine vessel "intruded" into the "Chinese territorial waters of Huangyan Island" as part of a "staged drama". Huangyan is the Chinese name for Bajo de Masinloc--a feature that is in fact well within the Philippines' exclusive economic zone (EEZ). The break down video insinuated that the Philippine vessel purposely "cut across the sailing past of a Chinese Coast Guard (CCG) ship". This was supposedly done to trigger a water cannon response from the CCG ship, which a CNN crew on the much smaller local vessel captured. "Manila wanted to put on a tough performance and win support from its boss, but the performance fell flat," claimed the video, which added that this took place at the time of the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting in the Philippines. US officials attended the meeting. China justifying its hostilities in WPS Senior Deputy Minority Leader Mamamayang Liberal (ML) Party-list Rep. Leila de Lima blasted the particular page for spewing lies about the Philippines' exercise of its sovereignty in the WPS. "We condemn this kind of content that clearly peddle fake news and disinformation about what is really happening in the [WPS]. Such content echoes China’s propaganda and misleads the public by justifying its hostilities and incursions into Philippine territory ," she said. De Lima called on ths DICT and other concerned agencies to closely monitor such content and similar pages and "urgently implement the necessary measures to prevent the spread of fake news and disinformation". "Our government should also strengthen its collaboration with digital platforms to ensure that false and misleading content has no place in our digital space," she said. "Kung hindi tumitigil ang China sa panggigipit at pag-angkin sa hindi nila pagmamay-ari, at tuloy-tuloy ang pagpapakalat ng ganyang mga kasinungalingan, dapat lang na maging seryoso at mas agresibo pa ang gobyerno sa pagpapaunawa sa ating mamamayan, lalo na sa kabataan, sa halaga ng pagtatanggol sa ating teritoryo," the former senator reckoned. (If China does not stop its harassment and claims over what it does not own, and continues spreading such lies, then the government must be more serious and even more aggressive in educating our people, especially the youth, on the importance of defending our territory.) For Bicol Saro Party-list Rep. Terry Ridon, the Department of National Defense (DND) and National Security Council (NSC) must also flex its muscles when it comes to such content. "The DND and the NSC should flag all social media pages and content which propagate fake news, misinformation and disinformation relating to the nation’s lawful and legitimate rights over the [WPS]," said the Committee on Public Accounts chairman. "They should make representations before social media platforms for the removal of these pages and content on the basis of fake news, misinformation and disinformation," he added.

AFP hits Chinese Embassy for ‘deceptive narratives’ on Ayungin Shoal. The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) has rejected claims from the Chinese Embassy in Manila that the Philippines had promised to remove BRP Sierra Madre from Ayungin Shoal, calling Beijing’s narrative an attempt to rewrite history. AFP spokesperson Roy Vincent Trinidad, a retired admiral, said the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) speaks of “promises” and “demands but “very easily forgets its own track record of deceptive narratives in our waters.” “The AFP rejects the recent statement from the Chinese Embassy in Manila attempting to rewrite history regarding the presence of the BRP Sierra Madre at Ayungin Shoal,” he said. This was his response to a statement from Chinese Embassy Deputy Spokesperson Guo Wei accusing Manila of reneging on a commitment to remove the grounded warship from the shoal. Trinidad recalled how in 1995, China’s foreign ministry assured the Philippines and the international community that the octagonal wooden structures it built on Panganiban Reef (Mischief Reef) were “shelters for local fishermen” with no military purpose. “Today, those ‘shelters’ have been transformed into a fortified, 550-hectare military airbase complete with a 3,000-meter runway, missile emplacements, radar domes and naval berths,” Trinidad said. “Mischief Reef stands as a permanent, concrete monument to their deceptive strategy in the West Philippine Sea.” he added. The AFP stressed that unlike China’s island-building on low-tide elevations inside the Philippine exclusive economic zone, the grounding of the BRP Sierra Madre in 1999 was a lawful sovereign act. “The presence of the BRP Sierra Madre on Ayungin Shoal is a lawful, permanent sovereign deployment on a feature over which we exercise sovereign rights and jurisdiction,” Trinidad stressed. He added that the 2016 Arbitral Tribunal ruling, which invalidated China’s claims in the South China Sea, also affirmed Ayungin Shoal as a low-tide elevation within the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone (EEZ). “No binding commitment was made to remove the BRP Sierra Madre from Ayungin Shoal,” Trinidad said. “The AFP remains firm in executing its mandate to protect Philippine national sovereignty, uphold international law, and maintain our presence on Ayungin Shoal. We will never abandon BRP Sierra Madre,” he added. The national government had deliberately grounded BRP Sierra Madre, a World War II warship now in a dilapidated state, on Ayungin Shoal in 1999. Guo said Beijing lodged formal protests in that same year and demanded the ship be towed away. “The Philippine side promised, again and again, that it would tow that rusty hulk out of there. It has been 27 years and the ship is still there. China demands the broken ship be towed away immediately,” Guo claimed.

LTFRB suspends jeepney in fatal San Mateo road crash. The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) has suspended for 30 days the operation of a passenger jeepney that allegedly hit and killed a 43-year-old motorcycle rider in San Mateo, Rizal. The agency said it has launched an investigation into the fatal road crash, which occurred on Thursday, Aug. 20. It also issued a show cause order (SCO) against the jeepney operator and directed the surrender of the vehicle’s license plate on or before the first hearing of the case on Sept. 4. Acting LTFRB Chairperson Greg Pua said the suspension would remain in effect pending the results of the investigation. Citing the initial police investigation, the LTFRB said the driver of the jeepney bearing license plate TWS 560 was allegedly speeding to pick up more passengers. The driver reportedly overtook several vehicles and entered the opposite lane before colliding with the motorcycle. The rider was rushed to the nearest hospital but was declared dead due to the serious injuries she sustained in the crash. In the SCO, the LTFRB directed the operator to explain in a notarized written response why the jeepney’s franchise should not be revoked over several alleged violations, including the employment of a reckless driver. The agency said its administrative investigation is separate from the probe being conducted by the Philippine National Police and other agencies into the driver’s possible criminal liability. “We are saddened by this unfortunate incident and we in the LTFRB extend our deepest condolences to the family of the rider. We assure the family that we will expedite the investigation into this case in the interest of accountability and justice,” Pua said. Jeep operator summoned over viral QC counterflow video Meanwhile, the LTFRB has summoned the operator of a passenger jeepney caught counterflowing along Quirino Highway in Quezon City. The agency said it issued an SCO directing the operator to explain in writing why the jeepney’s franchise should not be suspended or revoked for alleged violations of road safety rules. The acting LTFRB chairperson said the hearing has been set for Sept. 3. The LTFRB issued the order after its social media team monitored a viral video showing the jeepney counterflowing along the busy highway. Pua said the maneuver endangered other road users and warned public utility vehicle drivers against reckless behavior. “Let this investigation serve as a strong message to the PUV drivers that the LTFRB will not tolerate this kind of behavior on the road. Clark takes 5-shot lead over McIlroy, Cantlay at BMW Championship. ST. LOUIS (AP) — Wyndham Clark was doing everything right until it all went wrong Saturday at the BMW Championship. Just not for long. Bogey-free through 36 holes, he went from the bunker left of the fairway to the right rough on the opening hole at Bellerive. He came up short of the green, chipped to 7 feet and missed the putt, taking a double bogey that cost him the lead. The conversation on the second tee included a few choice words and a message from his caddie to embrace the challenge and move on. Clark wound up finding another gear. He had five birdies in an eight-hole stretch and turned a bad start into a big lead. Even closing with a bogey, Clark had a 5-under 65 and a five-shot lead. “Hit a bad shot on 2, but then really made a nice recovery and then got into a nice groove after that,” Clark said. It was the second time this year Clark has led by at least five shots going into the final round. He had a six-shot advantage at the U.S. Open and held on to win by one for his second major. Rory McIlroy ran off three straight birdies late in the round and saved par from a bunker on the 18th for a 65. Patrick Cantlay birdied the 18th for a 66. They were tied for second, a position far more relevant to Cantlay. He is at No. 43 in the FedEx Cup and needs a high finish to be among the top 30 who advance to the FedEx Cup finale next week in Atlanta. “That's a lot to make up,” McIlroy said of his deficit. “But if I focus on myself, try to shoot a good score — I shot a 64 and a 65 this week — shoot something similar tomorrow, you never know.” Gary Woodland, trying to cap off his remarkable year with a return to the Tour Championship, only managed two birdies in a round of 70. He was six shots behind, perhaps too far back to challenge Clark but high enough to extend his season another week. He was tied with Chris Gotterup (68). Clark made a tough par save from the bunker on No. 6. Then after hearing the crowd erupt for Woodland's 15-foot birdie on the par-4 seventh, Clark followed with a 10-foot birdie, and that was the start of a one of those hot streaks where he looks like he can't miss. He hit a 5-wood to 12 feet for eagle on the par-5 eighth. He holed a 30-foot birdie putt on the 10th, another birdie on the 11th from about 15 feet. And then he made a pair of birdie putts from the 12-foot range on the 13th and 14th to start pulling away. “You start seeing the lines and you’re so much more committed” Clark said of his putting. “You’re like, ‘OK, that’s exactly it.’ And then you just stroke it and the ball goes in.” Clark is going for his third win this year, which would put him in the conversation for PGA Tour player of the year with his major championship. Otherwise, Sunday is a matter of who gets to East Lake in Atlanta, where all 30 players only have to win to claim the FedEx Cup and the $10 million payoff. Justin Thomas took a step back with a 71, leaving him in a tie for 15th. Sungjae Im shot 70 and was alone in seventh. He can't afford to fall any farther down the leaderboard if he wants to keep alive his streak of being at East Lake every year dating to his rookie season in 2019. Sunday also is the cutoff to get the six automatic spots on the Presidents Cup. Clark is likely a lock even without moving into the top six spots. Ben Griffin shot a 68 but was still tied for 35th, jeopardizing his chances of being on the U.S. team at Medinah next month. Cantlay is too far back to be an automatic qualifier, but getting to East Lake goes a long way toward being an easy pick. “I feel like my game’s in a good spot and ready to go shoot a low one tomorrow,” Cantlay said. Scottie Scheffler shot 68 and was tied for 15th, 12 shots out of the lead.

Official search for missing teen in Mountain Province ends after 14 days. SAGADA, Mountain Province – The 14-day intensive search for 17-year-old Sofia Isabela Magalgalit Oria ended Saturday without finding the missing teenager, but municipal authorities vowed to continue to look for the victim. Police said the Incident Command Post (ICP) for the search operation in Barangay Dagdag was closed on Aug. 22 after serving as the operational center of the search for two weeks. However, the municipal Emergency Operations Center (EOC) remains active to coordinate succeeding search efforts and provide support to responders and volunteers. Authorities said the search covered an estimated 1,599.98 hectares, with 89 responders and volunteers organized into 17 teams during the final day. Search-and-rescue dogs Ninong, Rocky and Jake, along with their handlers, were also deployed to difficult terrain in Kanipawan, Kiltepan and Tatayaen. The operation involved police, firefighters, soldiers, disaster-response teams, local volunteers and residents, with support from neighboring municipalities and provinces. The search also extended beyond Mountain Province. In Kalinga, Gov. James Edduba ordered a river watch along the Chico River in support of the operation. In Pasil, local responders, the municipal disaster office, the Bureau of Fire Protection and police monitored portions of the river for possible signs or information that could help locate Sofia. Other communities and groups provided assistance through river and waterway monitoring, food, transportation, equipment, communications, logistics and financial support. Sagada officials said residents and volunteers who wish to continue searching may coordinate with the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office for proper deployment. The public was also urged to report credible information or possible sightings through appropriate channels. Sofia’s family thanked the responders, volunteers, donors, government agencies and communities who supported the search, saying their hope for her safe return remains. “Although the search may have changed, our hope remains,” the family said. “Sofia, we are still waiting for you.”

Cordillera’s most wanted arrested in Abra over 39 counts of rape of a minor. Erwin Tulfo calls for better parenting amid spate of school violence. Hands-on parenting is key to avoiding potential acts of violence among schoolchildren. Thus, said Senator Erwin Tulfo, who urged parents and guardians on Sunday, Aug. 23 to strengthen communication lines with their children and avoid relying solely on technology to monitor their well-being. His appeal comes after a gun was found inside the bag of Grade 9 student in Pinamungajan, Cebu— just days after the tragic shooting at the Ateneo de Zamboanga University (ADZU) that left two schoolchildren dead and nine others injured. Authorities reported that the said gun retrieved in Cebu belonged the student’s grandfather. “It really starts at home. What made these kids think that it’s alright to bring weapons at school?” Tulfo, chairman of Senate Committee on Social Justice, Welfare, and Rural Development said in a statement. “This should be a lesson for everybody, for every parent, guardian out there. Please, please talk to your children, talk to your child. We should ask if they’re okay and really know what's going on inside their mind,” he added. The Senator notes that no child is naturally born violent saying, “There are so many instances that can trigger their violence and we cannot guide them toward the right track if we do not start dealing with them genuinely.” Stricter gun control Addressing the alarming gun access of children, Tulfo stressed that parents and guardians who are firearm holders must be held accountable, especially those who negligently leave the weapons within children’s reach. He then announced that a legislation was underway to impose criminal liability to negligent gun owners and custodians. “We cannot wait for another fatality or more collateral damage. There has to be a law that will strengthen the existing framework on firearm ownership,” Tulfo said. “The intention is clear: ensure that every child will not have access to a firearm, gun-owning parents and guardians practice responsible ownership, and that no firearm entrusted to either a public or private individual, will ever become an instrument of tragedy in the hands of a child,” he concluded.

Share BlueSky Email Facebook Linkedin Twitter Whatsapp Save Print Related Tags Russia Ukraine In this episode of War & Peace , Olga is joined by Sabine Fischer, senior fellow at the German Institute for International and Security Affairs (SWP), to discuss her book “The Chauvinist Threat: Russia’s War and the West’s Response”. They unpack how chauvinist politics – defined as a combination of imperialism, sexism and autocracy – have shaped Russian society and politics under President Vladimir Putin and helped pave the way for Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine. They examine how the war has accelerated chauvinism in Russia, including through pressure on women to have children, rising domestic violence and the repression of feminist and LGBTQI+ activism, while also raising the war’s complex effects on gender relations in Ukraine. They also consider how different outcomes to the war could shape Russia’s future and politics across Europe, what guardrails liberal democracies, including those in the process of re-arming, have against chauvinist shifts, and whether and how chauvinist politics might be reversed. TERREMOTO IN TURCHIA E SIRIA:DECINE DI MIGLIAIA DI DISPERSI. Il bilancio sale a 11.200 vittime, si continua a scavare tra le macerie. Decine di migliaia i dispersi, tra loro anche l’italiano Angelo Zen. Sono ancora centinaia le scosse di assestamento tra macerie e devastazione: i soccorritori hanno a che fare con temperature rigidissime. Secondo l’Oms potrebbero essere state colpite 23 milioni di persone, tra cui 1,4 milioni di bambini. In Turchia, nel frattempo, monta la rabbia degli sfollati perché è stata descritta come una risposta lenta e inadeguata da parte delle autorità: sono migliaia le persone alla ricerca di un riparo. Erdogan ammette che ci sono stati inizialmente dei problemi. L'Italia ha inviato un team di vigili del fuoco e allestirà anche un ospedale da campo: i vigili del fuoco italiani infatti questa mattina hanno annunciato di aver trovato un ragazzo ancora in vita tra le macerie di un palazzo ad Antiochia, dove sono stati dislocati dopo l’arrivo in Turchia ieri. Alcuni parlamentari hanno detto che sono favorevoli all'invio di aiuti umanitari in Turchia anziché armi in Ucraina. Il sisma di magnitudo 7.9 dello scorso 6 febbraio 2023 è stato avvertito anche in Groenlandia, a oltre 5.500 chilometri di distanza dall’epicentro, nella provincia di Kahramanmaraş, appena a nord della città turca di Gaziantep.

FIGA COL MONCLER:IL BRANO CHE STA SPOPOLANDO SU TIKTOK. “ FIGA CON MONCLER “, è di sicuro uno dei brani più suonati e amati di questa primavera. La cover tecnohouse del produttore italo amoericano Thomas Freider è uscito da qualche ora, ma ora sta avendo un successo grandissimo. Ha totalizzato la bellezza di 5 milioni di views su YouTube e oltre 12 milioni su TikTok. Ma perché tutto questo clamore ? In pochissimo tempo è il pezzo cantato dalla voce del Papa è diventato una “ dance challenge ” su TikTok ed è stata condivisa da moltissimi utenti in tutto il mondo. “ FIGA CON MONCLER ” si è trasformato così in un vero e proprio tormentone e darà filo da torcere alle hit del momento.

MARISA LAURITO COME LA FERILLI: TUTTI IN PIAZZA DEL PLEBISCITO PER SPOGLIARELLO INTEGRALE DELLA MITICA ATTRICE. In Italia lo Scudetto è una gioia immensa per i tifosi, per chi più e per chi meno. Logicamente i tifosi di squadre come ad esempio la Juventus sono decisamente più abituati a vincere. Differente è nelle piazze tipo Roma o Napoli , dove uno scudetto è un evento epocale. Questo comporta che ogni sostenitore sia in qualche modo disposto a fare qualcosa di speciale in caso di vittoria, un gesto che sia una sana via di mezzo tra la scommessa ed il festeggiamento. Ecco quindi che si è avuta la genesi dello “ spogliarello Scudetto “. Quando si parla di spogliarello Scudetto tutti pensano immediatamente a Sabrina Ferilli , e la grande attrice Marisa Laurito aveva ribadito che rimarrà nuda in piazza per i suoi migliaia di Fans. Ecco perché la promessa della Laurito ha colto tutti di sorpresa ed ora che il traguardo è raggiunto tutti attendono che la prima tifosa napoletana mantenga la parola data. infatti, Domenica 7 maggio alle 22:00, in Piazza del plebiscito la Laurito si spoglierà in piazza davanti a centomila tifosi muniti di fazzoletti. CATASTROFE IN EMILIA:ARRIVANO GLI AIUTI DALLA RUSSIA. La mobilitazione è stata rapidissima. Venerdì Putin ha chiamato l'amico Berlusconi, sabato pomeriggio il primo jet è decollato da una grande base alle porte di Mosca e nella serata è arrivato all'aeroporto militare a Pratica di Mare. Altri otto seguiranno nel giro di ore. Tutti i materiali raggiungeranno poi la l'Emilia Romagna e le zone colpite dalla grande alluvione. Le foto diffuse dal ministero della Difesa russo mostrano la colonna di mezzi che sale sui velivoli. Si notano alcuni camion militari, una fila di ufficiali e diversi furgoni con aiuti medici. Si contano anche 8 idrovore di ultima generazione, utilizzate per prosciugare il lago Bajkal. Il personale proviene dai ranghi della Protezione Civile, che fa capo al ministero dell’Interno, e da quelli delle forze armate. Dovrebbero essere parte delle unità pronte all’azione per fronteggiare le catastrofi e addestrate allo scenario della catastrofe alluvionale. E per questo in grado di operare con efficacia nella battaglia contro le acque.

MISTER FERGUSON SUL CASO JUVENTUS: "NELLA PREMIER VERREBBE RADIATA". ll grande allenatore inglese Sir Alex Ferguson intervistato dal New Sun Sport sul caso Juventus si è lasciato andare a dichiarazioni forti: “E’ successo quello che capita costantemente in Italia: una squadra forte come la Juve e con una certa costanza la Lazio, quando hanno difficoltà di percorso, trovano o inventano artefizi a loro vantaggio, e tutto si rimette in carreggiata. E’ sempre la stessa storia: gioiscono gli stessi e altri pagano dazio per farli gioire”. "La Juventus ha imbrogliato ed è stata sleale. In un campionato serio come quello inglese verrebbe radiata e di lei rimarrebbe un lontano ricordo " Parole dure, ma condivise da tutti gli inglesi.

CALABRIA: SALVIAMO LO SCOGLIO DEL DELFINO. Ad Africo(prov. di Reggio Calabria) e dintorni tutta la popolazione si sta mobilitando per salvare il famosissimo "Scoglio del Delfino" sita nelle mitiche scogliere di Africo. L'iniziativa è stata promossa dalle varie associazioni nazionali e internazionali affinché l'erosione calcarea e la stupidità d alcuni turisti non rovini questa meravigliosa forma d'arte scultorea che Madre Natura ci ha regalato. A causa di alcuni turisti col vizio di staccare, armati d martelletto, pezzi di roccia da portare a casa come souvenir, la parte anteriore dello Scoglio del Delfino è profondamente lesionata. E come se non bastasse, anche pescatori d frodo muniti di bombole e scalpello stanno minando le fondamenta a caccia di avalloni e datteri di mare. Per questo bisogna salvarla con un intervento di messa in sicurezza serio e risolutore.

WIJNALDUM COME PEDRO: DALLA ROMA ALLA LAZIO. TRATTATIVA IN FASE AVANZATA. Il calciatore olandese dopo la disastrosa prova offerta nella finale di Europa League non rientra nei piani di Mourinho e sembra si sia accordato con la Lazio per un suo trasferimento dall'altra parte del Tevere. Il trasferimento è a costo zero, la Roma non percerpirà nessun indenizzo da parte dei biancocelesti e risparmierà sull'ingaggio pesante del calciatore. Al PSG detentore del cartellino del calciatore andrà però un introito legato ai bonus di presenze o di raggiungimento di determinati obiettivi da parte del calciatore. Georgino Wijnaldum è in trattativa con la Lazio per un biennale da 3,5 milioni di euro e vestirà la maglia numero 30. Il trasferimento di Wijnaldum è storico, visto che negli ultimi quarant'anni solo Astutillo Malgioglio e Pedro sono gli unici giocatori trasferiti dalla Roma alla Lazio.

ORIGI, MESSIAS, ADLI E 25 MILIONI PER MILINKOVIC-SAVIC. LOTITO NE CHIEDE 35!!!. Il Milan, dopo lo scioccante siluramento di Paolo Maldini, punta al grande colpo per il calciomercato estivo: Sergej Milinkovic-Savic della Lazio . Lo ha riferito ' SportMediaset '. Il Diavolo, dunque, ha intenzione di andare all'assalto del centrocampista serbo, classe 1995 , che gioca nella Capitale dal 2015 e che ora sembra arrivato al momento dei saluti. Nonostante il contratto di Milinkovic-Savic scadrà tra un anno, il 30 giugno 2024 , il Presidente della Lazio, Claudio Lotito , continua a valutarlo molto. Si parla di 35-40 milioni di euro, per un giocatore che, in fin dei conti, in questa stagione con le Aquile di Maurizio Sarri si è riconfermato come uno dei centrocampisti più forti e completi del panorama calcistico mondiale. Motivo per cui il Milan, pur di metterlo a disposizione di Stefano Pioli in questo calciomercato estivo, sarebbe pronto ad offrire alla Lazio 25 milioni più ben tre contropartite tecniche individuati in Junior Messias , Divock Origi e Yacine Adli. Le contropartite tecniche sarebbero di gradimento per Mister Sarri e si adatterebbero facilmente al suo gioco spettacolare: Adli può ricoprire diversi ruoli del centrocampo e sarebbe un sostituto ideale del capitano biancoazzurro; Messias , visto il flop di Romero e l'età avanzata di Pedro, sarebbe un'ottima alternativa di fascia visto i tanti impegni che aspettano la Lazio; Origi sarebbe una discreta opzione a Ciro Immobile, lasciando crescere con tranquillità il talentuoso Cancellieri. La palla passa a Lotito che attende un rialzo di offerta magari intorno ai 30 milioni e l'inserimento di tre contropartite tecniche di buon livello per concludere l'affare.

TESSERA ONORARIA E MAGLIETTA RICORDO. I LAZIALI SCATENATI. Anthony Taylor socio onorario del Lazio Club. È questo il modo in cui tifosi biancocelesti del luogo hanno pensato di rifarsi contro la tifoseria romanista, dopo la “barbara aggressione dei sostenitori giallorossi” – come l’hanno definita loro – all’aeroporto di Budapest hanno pensato di esprimere la loro “vicinanza” all’arbitro inglese noto alle cronache per gli errori arbitrali durante la finale di Europa League. Così, il un articolo de ‘Il Messaggero’, il Lazio Club Pomezia ha deciso di staccare una tessera onoraria proprio a nome di Anthony Taylor, il fischietto che ha danneggiato la Roma in finale di Europa League scatenando le proteste e l’amarezza di Mourinho e i romanisti. I tifosi del Lazio Club "Franco Tripodi" di Cesano invece hanno fatto una maglietta commemorativa della maglia laziale con la scritta Taylor.

LAZIO: NON SOLO BERARDI, ECCO HAZARD!!!. Nonostante una campionato giocato ad alti livelli, i limiti della rosa (specialmente in termini numerici) sono stati evidenti. Essere competitivi su più fronti per dare continuità a quanto fatto quest'anno, centrando consecutivamente l'accesso in Champions nei prossimi anni. Questo è ciò a cui la Lazio , a detta di Sarri stesso, deve puntare nelle prossime stagioni. Giocatori forti e pronti: questo l'identikit tracciato da Sarri per il mercato ormai alle porte. Seguito con grande interesse c'è Domenico Berardi che, dopo l'ultima partita stagionale ha parlato di Champions come obiettivo. E' stata messa sul tavolo un'offerta da 20 milioni più il cartellino di Matteo Cancellieri. Ma Lotito è scatenato e vuole regalare alla piazza biancoceleste un grande colpo. Ieri c'è stata una lunga chiaccherata telefonica con il presidente del Real dove si è tastata la possibilità di cedere Hazard col prestito gratuito e il pagamento di metà dell'ingaggio. Il giocatore sarebbe contento di trasferirsi nella capitale e su questa base è stata avviata una trattativa, magari inserendo il Sergente.

CONFERENCE LEAGUE :POSSIBILE 0-3 A TAVOLINO PER LA FIORENTINA. I TIFOSI VIOLA CI SPERANO!!!. Gli otto punti rimediati da Cristiano Biraghi in finale di Conference League contro il West Ham hanno fatto molto discutere, non soltanto per il gesto vergognoso. Tra le questioni affrontate anche quella dell’interruzione della partita e del 3-0 a tavolino, provvedimenti su cui l’arbitro Del Cerro Grande, da norma, non può nulla. È la Commissione Disciplinare Uefa a decidere. Andiamo quindi a spulciare il regolamento. Tra i casi in cui i club devono rispondere delle azioni della tifoseria c’è anche “il lancio di oggetti che possa mettere in pericolo l’integrità fisica di altri presenti alla partita o pregiudicarne lo svolgimento”. Il paradosso è che Biraghi, per sperare in un 3-0 a tavolino, avrebbe dovuto accentuare il dolore e farsi sostituire, invece è stato “colpevole” di essersi grintosamente rialzato. Per dare un’idea del modo in cui viene messo in pratica il regolamento, prendiamo in esame un caso simile: il famoso petardo in testa a Dida nel derby di Milano del 2004-2005. In quel caso le autorità capiscono che la situazione non può avere seguito e inoltre il brasiliano resta a terra. Per questo motivo, viene assegnato il 3-0 a tavolino ai rossoneri. In sostanza, il West Ham al momento rischia solo una pesante sanzione pecuniaria e la squalifica del campo nella prossima edizione dell’Europa League. Un caso simile, alla Fiorentina , è capitato nella stessa competizione contro il Sivasspor, in Turchia. Alessandro Bianco riceve un pugno in faccia da un invasore di campo della squadra di casa. Il calciatore rimedia la frattura del setto nasale. Per i turchi è arrivata una dura sanzione, più l’impossibilità di andare allo stadio per una giornata per i tifosi.

TUTTI PAZZI PER GEDSON FERNANDES. ECCO CHI E' TALENTO SULLA CIMA DEI DESIDERI DI MISTER SARRI. Uno dei nomi caldi per il centrocampo della Lazio è quello di Gedson Fernandes del Besiktas . Il portoghese classe 1999 ma nato nella Repubblica Democratica di São Tomé e Príncipe in Africa , piace tantissimo al tecnico biancoceleste Sarri che sembra lo abbia messo in cima alla liste delle priorità per il centrocampo. Cresciuto nel Benfica dopo aver fatto tutta la trafila nel club lusitano e aver debuttato in prima squadra nel 2020 è passato al Tottenham . L'anno dopo è passato al Galatasaray per poi tornare alla base dopo pochi mesi. Nel febbraio 2022 tenta nuovamente la fortuna in Turchia con la maglia del Çaykur Rizespor mentre nell'ultima stagione ha vestito la maglia del Besiktas con cui ha collezionato 33 presenze condite da 3 gol e 6 assist. "Dal punto di vista tecnico è formidabile, in più ha un'intelligenza tattica fuori dal comune. Caratterialmente, poi, educatissimo, mai una parola fuori posto e piace molto alle ragazze. In poche parole, un predestinato per eccellenza. Con mister Sarri può diventare tra i cinque centrocampisti più forti al mondo se capirà il calcio italiano" Queste le parole di Senol Gunes allenatore del Besiktas, grande amico di mister Sarri e noto simpatizzante laziale.

MISTER SARRI: VOGLIO BOLOCA. Fino a qualche tempo fa lo conoscevano in pochi. Ora però il nome di Daniel Boloca inizia a circolare insistentemente anche tra i club di Serie A. Merito di una stagione strepitosa con il Frosinone : il mediano classe 1998 è tra i protagonisti della promozione dei canarini. Grosso non ha mai rinunciato a lui, mandandolo in campo con grande continuità. Al termine della stagione il bilancio è di 31 presenze (di cui 29 da titolare) e 2 gol all'attivo. Il suo rendimento non è passato inosservato e diversi club della massima serie avrebbero messo gli occhi sul talento nato a Chieri. Oltre alla Lazio , Boloca è stato accostato a Fiorentina, Bologna e Sassuolo. La nostra testata ha intervistato in esclusiva Giorgio Boscarato , agente FIFA che lo ha seguito agli inizi della carriera e ci ha detto di lui: "Daniel secondo me è pronto per la Serie A, magari subito in una big, e con un club che possa valorizzarlo sono convinto che nel giro di un anno possa arrivare la chiamata in Nazionale. Lui può giocare sia come vertice davanti alla difesa sia nei due centrali di centrocampo. Dicono che a Sarri piaccia molto e sono convinto che Daniel sia un giocatore che più si alza l'asticella più possa fare meglio. Non dimentichiamo che è un grande rubacuori e ad ogni fine allenamento posa per decine e decine di selfie per le tante ragazze che vengono a salutarlo".

LAZIO OCCHI SU FAZZINI:COLPO DA CHAMPIONS. La Lazio pensa al mercato, anche in prospettiva, e secondo quanto riportato da La Gazzetta dello Sport le attenzioni dei biancocelesti sono su Jacopo Fazzini , centrocampista classe 2003 dell'Empoli. Il giovane può giocare in grado di giocare a tutto campo e questa peculiarità ha fatto presa su Sarri. Molto dinamico. Abile a inserirsi negli spazi stretti come pure ad avanzare palla al piede. Nel 4-3-3 del tecnico laziale potrebbe essere inserito come interno, ma lo stesso Sarri lo considera in grado di agire pure da vertice basso. Fazzini ha rinnovato con i toscani fino al 2027 ed è stato convocato per l'Europeo Under 21 da Nicolato, con la Lazio che potrebbe provare a prenderlo inserendo nella trattativa Akpa Akpro e uno tra Bertini e Floriani Mussolini.

GUNDOGAN VIA DAL MANCHESTER! IL MILAN SULLE SUE TRACCE, MA OCCHIO ALLA ROMA. Dopo aver perso due finali, una quando era ancora al Borussia Dortmund, alla fine Ilkay Gundogan ci è riuscito: ieri sera il centrocampista tedesco ha alzato al cielo la Champions League per la prima volta, sia per lui che per il Manchester City. Grande protagonista nella cavalcata europea dei Citizens, in molti sospettano però che il futuro del 32enne possa essere altrove. Il suo contratto è in scadenza nel prossimo 30 giugno e al momento non c'è notizia di un suo rinnovo e anzi suonano le sirene di mercato. Il Milan cerca rinforzi e, viste le ristrettezze finanziarie con cui è costretto a fare i conti da qualche tempo a questa parte, poter inserire un giocatore come il nazionale tedesco appare prospettiva allettante. Le prossime settimane ci diranno se, come iniziano a dire in sempre di più, dopo la Champions vinta seguirà l'addio di Gundogan al Man City. In uno scenario il Milan , interessato da tempo al tedesco, ha già anticipato tutti proponendo un triennale, ma occhio a Mourinho pronto a convincere il giocatore con cui c'è un ottimo feeeling.

IL PIANO DELLA LAZIO PER FRATTESI. MA LOTITO NON VUOLE RICONOSCERE IL 30% ALLA ROMA. La Lazio è già al lavoro per il mercato estivo. Le aquile biancocelesti stanno per ufficializzare il colpo Berardi e sono pronti a chiudere per Fazzini. Ora gli sforzi del Presidentissimo Lotito sono su un altro centrocampista e sulla punta che possa affiancare Ciro Immobile . Uno degli obiettivi della squadra di Sarri è Davide Frattesi. I rapporti tra Lotito e Sassuolo sono ottimi da tempo, infatti, i materiali per la ristrutturazione di Villa San Sebastiano sono targati Mapei. Secondo Il Tempo, sotto la lente del ds Carnevali sono finiti Floriani Mussolini e Moro. I due talenti ex primavera potrebbero rientrare in un piano più grande che prevederebbe l’arrivo in biancoazzurro di Davide Frattesi. Il centrocampista piace da molto tempo a Sarri ma la trattativa è ferma ad un mese. La distanza tra domanda e offerta rimane ampia e per questo le pedine di alcuni talenti della primavera potrebbero far cambiare le cose. La concorrenza per il romano no manca ma la fede laziale del calciatore e la lunga corte della Lazio sono le armi che Lotito potrebbe utilizzare per concludere al meglio la trattativa. Lotito attraverso i suoi legali, sta elaborando una strategia per evitare di dover riconoscere il 30% della vendita di Frattesi alla Roma, che si aggirerebbe tra i 10 e i 12 milioni.

LAGIORNATA MONDIALE DELLE TARTARUGHE MARINE. Sono già una dozzina i nidi censiti dal network tartarughe marine del WWF in Sicilia (proprio in queste ore sono in corso le operazioni di verifica e messa in sicurezza degli ultimi), e uno in Calabria. Il Mediterraneo, sebbene rappresenti solo una piccola percentuale della superficie totale degli oceani, lo 0.82%, ospita una straordinaria varietà di vita marina. Con oltre 17.000 specie diverse, questa regione è un importante hotspot di biodiversità marina. E tra questa vasta varietà di specie, le tartarughe marine occupano un posto speciale. Nel Mediterraneo, tre specie di tartarughe marine hanno fatto di queste acque la loro casa: la tartaruga comune (Caretta caretta, l’unica che vi si riproduce), la tartaruga verde (Chelonia mydas) e la tartaruga liuto (Dermochelys coriacea). Le tartarughe marine trascorrono la maggior parte della loro vita in mare, ma, come altri rettili, respirano aria tramite i polmoni. La deposizione delle uova è l’unica fase vitale che avviene sulla terraferma, di solito tra maggio e agosto nel Mediterraneo. Dopo l’accoppiamento, le femmine raggiungono la spiaggia per deporre le uova, che vengono incubate dal calore del sole (e del suolo) per circa due mesi. La temperatura influisce anche sul sesso delle tartarughe neonate: temperature superiori a 29°C tendono a produrre femmine, mentre temperature inferiori generano maschi. Dopo la deposizione delle uova, le femmine ritornano alle loro zone di alimentazione, che possono trovarsi anche a migliaia di chilometri di distanza dalle zone di riproduzione. Una volta raggiunta la maturità sessuale, intorno ai 20-30 anni, le tartarughe ritornano alle stesse aree di riproduzione per deporre le uova. La loro capacità di orientarsi durante queste lunghe migrazioni è influenzata dall’incredibile abilità di percepire il campo geomagnetico terrestre, una sorta di sesto senso di queste antichissime specie. L’impatto dei cambiamenti climatici. L’aumento delle temperature globali influisce direttamente sull’habitat di queste creature e sulle risorse di cui dipendono per la loro sopravvivenza, oltre che sulle correnti. Uno degli effetti più evidenti è l’aumento della temperatura dell’acqua. Le tartarughe marine sono specie ectotermiche, il che significa che la loro temperatura corporea dipende dall’ambiente circostante. Con l’aumento delle temperature marine, le tartarughe possono trovarsi in situazioni di stress termico, poiché non sono in grado di regolare la propria temperatura interna. Questo può influire sul loro metabolismo, sulla loro capacità di digerire il cibo e sull’efficienza riproduttiva.

BONUS VACANZE: SCADENZA DELLE DOMANDE IL 30 GIUGNO. La procedura per la richiesta del Bonus vacanze va effettuata solamente online tramite la app “Io” da smartphone. Basta munirsi di Spid o della carta d’identità elettronica. Lo possono richiedere soltanto i nuclei familiari con un reddito Isee sotto i 40.000 euro e può essere speso solo per un soggiorno in Italia entro la fine dell’anno. Una volta ottenuto il Bonus, la prenotazione della vacanza non può essere effettuata su siti online: quindi non è possibile prenotare né con Booking né con Airbnb o con altri siti di prenotazione. Bisogna, invece, prenotare tramite agenzie viaggi o o tour operator tradizionali o direttamente con la struttura scelta nella meta di villeggiatura. Ecco gli step per fare la richiesta del Bonus vacanze: se non si è già scaricata la app “Io” in passato sul proprio smartphone è possibile farlo sia per telefoni Apple sia per Android; la prima volta che si scarica la app viene richiesta la registrazione che è possibile fare più facilmente digitando un Pin a scelta o, per chi è più pratico, attraverso il riconoscimento biometrico (impronta digitale o riconoscimento del volto); una volta entrati nella app, bisogna selezionare la sezione “pagamenti” e quindi il Bonus vacanze; a questo punto è necessario inserire le informazioni richieste, tra cui il valore dell’Isee; se tutte le informazioni inserite sono corrette, la app genera un codice associato al vostro Bonus vacanze con un QrCode; sia il codice sia il QrCode devono essere mostrati alla struttura al momento del pagamento. N.B. Prima di effettuare la richiesta del Bonus vacanze è bene tenere sotto mano sia la propria identità Spid sia la carta d’identità elettronica e i dati del proprio Isee (chi non lo ricorda può recuperarlo all’Inps o al proprio Caf). Il Bonus di un valore massimo di 500 euro è rivolto alle famiglie italiane composte da almeno tre persone. Per i nuclei familiari composti da due persone il Bonus vacanze scende a 300 euro, ma lo possono ottenere anche i single, in questo caso il valore è di 150 euro.
